note: 0.1.4 T-14 review: claude_pid takes Claude Code's start time from this session's classic-alive.json when that record names the same pid, except in hook SessionStart, the hook that writes the record: a new Claude Code process may get the pid of the session's earlier one (a container with fixed pids, `claude --resume`), and a record trusted there would keep the earlier start time for good (identity::alive would then read the live session as gone). The runner stands in for Claude Code through the real walk (CLAUDE_PID = the runner's pid, no STORE_TEST_CLAUDE_PID): a resume after the record was seeded with another start time for the same pid writes the runner's real one

steps.name: startup: the record holds the runner's start time
the record of the session's earlier process, which had the same pid and another start time
resume in the new process: SessionStart reads the start time itself and writes it
